criteria_results.title: ISSUE_001: Identifies oral disclosure confirmation period shortened to 5 days
criteria_results.reasoning: States draft § 1.4 requires written confirmation within 5 business days versus the Playbook's preferred 15 business days.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_002: Identifies confidential information presumption clause
criteria_results.reasoning: Flags § 1.2 blanket presumption as a Walk-Away that inverts the burden and requires affirmative de-designation.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_003: Identifies extended NDA term (24 vs. 18 months)
criteria_results.reasoning: Identifies the 24-month term against the Playbook's 18-month preferred term.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_003: Identifies extended survival period (3 years vs. 2 years)
criteria_results.reasoning: Identifies 3-year survival versus the 2-year Playbook maximum.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_004: Identifies exclusion of accountants, financial advisors, and lenders
criteria_results.reasoning: Says Representatives are limited to officers, directors, employees and legal counsel, excluding Ridgeline/financial advisors, accountants and financing sources.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_004: Notes impact on Hightower's ability to share with financing sources
criteria_results.reasoning: Explains that sharing with Ridgeline or lenders would be a breach and that Hightower could not evaluate or finance the deal.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_005: Identifies pre-approved representative list and disclosure log requirement
criteria_results.reasoning: Identifies both the sole-discretion prior-consent requirement for anyone not on the pre-approved list and the mandatory disclosure log.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_006: Identifies compelled-disclosure notice period extended to 5 business days
criteria_results.reasoning: Identifies the 5-business-day pre-disclosure notice versus the Playbook's 2 business days (fallback 3).

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_006: Identifies cost-shifting for protective order legal fees
criteria_results.reasoning: Identifies § 4.2 cost-shifting of protective-order fees versus the Playbook's each-party-bears-own-costs rule.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_007: Identifies non-solicitation period extended to 18 months
criteria_results.reasoning: Identifies the 18-month post-termination non-solicit tail versus the Playbook's 12 months.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_007: Identifies missing general-solicitation carve-out
criteria_results.reasoning: Expressly flags the absence of any general-solicitation carve-out.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_008: Identifies 12-month standstill provision
criteria_results.reasoning: Describes the § 6 12-month standstill barring acquisitions of interests/assets, proposals and proxy solicitation.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_008: Identifies don't-ask-don't-waive clause
criteria_results.reasoning: Specifically calls out § 6.2 DADW as expressly prohibited by the Playbook.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_008: Discusses DADW fiduciary or legal concerns
criteria_results.reasoning: Analyzes DADW impact: bars even private requests to DataPulse's board for a revised proposal, makes the request itself a breach that could trigger liquidated damages, and freezes Hightower.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_009: Identifies absence of residuals clause
criteria_results.reasoning: Identifies the absence of a residuals clause as a Walk-Away.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_010: Identifies compressed return/destruction timeline (5 vs. 10 business days)
criteria_results.reasoning: Identifies the 5-business-day return/destruction period versus the Playbook's preferred 10 business days.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_010: Identifies missing carve-outs for legal archives and backup systems
criteria_results.reasoning: Identifies the missing legal-counsel archive and automatic-backup carve-outs.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_010: Identifies officer-level destruction certification requirement
criteria_results.reasoning: Identifies the VP-or-above sworn certification due within 3 business days after the 5-business-day period.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_011: Identifies governing law deviation (Texas vs. Delaware)
criteria_results.reasoning: Identifies Texas law and Travis County forum versus Delaware law and Court of Chancery/Superior Court.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_012: Identifies unilateral injunctive relief favoring only DataPulse
criteria_results.reasoning: Identifies one-way equitable relief in DataPulse's favor versus the Playbook's mutual relief.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_012: Identifies $5 million liquidated damages clause against Hightower
criteria_results.reasoning: Identifies $5,000,000 liquidated damages against Hightower as a Walk-Away.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_012: Discusses penalty doctrine or enforceability of liquidated damages
criteria_results.reasoning: Notes that stacking the fixed sum on actual damages undercuts the pre-estimate characterization and invites a penalty challenge.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_013: Identifies broad 24-month non-circumvention clause
criteria_results.reasoning: Identifies the 24-month non-circumvention covering identified customers/vendors/partners; Playbook preferred is no clause.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_013: Notes interference with Hightower's existing business relationships
criteria_results.reasoning: Discusses overlap with Hightower's existing customers/carriers and restriction of ordinary-course business, plus § 10.2 eliminating the pre-existing-relationship carve-out.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_014: Identifies assignment prohibition without merger/asset-sale exception
criteria_results.reasoning: Identifies that as to Hightower § 11.1 is a blanket consent requirement with no merger/asset-sale exception.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_015: Identifies embedded data privacy obligations in NDA
criteria_results.reasoning: Identifies embedded GDPR/CCPA-style terms (24-hour notice, DPIAs, Data Liaison Officer) and the Playbook's separate-DPA position.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_015: Notes draft's obligations exceed actual regulatory requirements
criteria_results.reasoning: Notes GDPR Art. 33's 72-hour benchmark and that the CCPA does not independently mandate DPIAs.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_016: Identifies unilateral publicity right for DataPulse
criteria_results.reasoning: Identifies DataPulse's sole-and-absolute-discretion right to announce strategic discussions as a Walk-Away against mutual consent.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_016: Discusses Regulation FD or market-impact concerns
criteria_results.reasoning: Discusses Regulation FD and the market-moving impact on NYSE-listed Hightower.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_017: Identifies asymmetric liability cap ($10M for DataPulse, uncapped for Hightower)
criteria_results.reasoning: Identifies the $10M cap on DataPulse with Hightower uncapped and says the Playbook allows no cap in any circumstances.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_018: Identifies third-party beneficiary designation
criteria_results.reasoning: Identifies § 16.1 designation of DataPulse members/managers/employees as third-party beneficiaries against the Playbook's no-third-party-beneficiaries position.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_019: Identifies missing jury trial waiver
criteria_results.reasoning: Identifies the missing mandatory jury-trial waiver.

criteria_results.title: DISTRACTOR_001: Does not flag indefinite trade-secret survival as a material deviation
criteria_results.reasoning: Treats indefinite trade-secret survival as acceptable and market.

criteria_results.title: DISTRACTOR_002: Confirms IP disclaimer (Section 15) is conforming
criteria_results.reasoning: Classifies § 15 IP disclaimer as Compliant.

criteria_results.title: DISTRACTOR_003: Confirms Entire Agreement clause (Section 17) is conforming
criteria_results.reasoning: Classifies § 17 Entire Agreement as Compliant.

criteria_results.title: DISTRACTOR_004: Confirms Amendment provision (Section 18) is conforming
criteria_results.reasoning: States amendment mechanics are compliant; the only noted gap is a Low-risk conforming edit to the separate Waiver clause, not a material deviation.

criteria_results.title: DISTRACTOR_005: Confirms Counterparts/Electronic Signatures (Section 19) is conforming
criteria_results.reasoning: Classifies § 19 Counterparts/E-signatures as Compliant.

criteria_results.title: Standstill rated Critical or High risk
criteria_results.reasoning: Standstill is rated Critical.

criteria_results.title: Exclusion of financing sources rated Critical or High risk
criteria_results.reasoning: Exclusion of financing sources (Provision 3) is rated Critical.

criteria_results.title: Oral confirmation period rated Medium or Low risk
criteria_results.reasoning: The oral confirmation deviation sits in Provision 1, which is rated High, not Medium or Low as the PASS condition requires.

criteria_results.title: Standstill recommendation is to reject
criteria_results.reasoning: Recommends striking § 6 in its entirety, including the DADW.

criteria_results.title: Report uses tabular format
criteria_results.reasoning: Uses multiple tables (deviation summary, per-provision tables, escalation matrix).

criteria_results.title: Each deviation entry includes all six required fields
criteria_results.reasoning: Each provision entry gives draft section, draft language, Playbook position, risk rating, recommendation and rationale (deviations identified).

criteria_results.title: Report identifies conforming provisions
criteria_results.reasoning: Lists compliant provisions 17, 20 and 22 and treats amendments as only a minor gap.

criteria_results.title: Report demonstrates independent analysis beyond cover email flags
criteria_results.reasoning: Goes well beyond standstill and publicity: representatives, residuals, liability cap, jury waiver, non-circumvention, data privacy, assignment and more.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_012: Remedies recommendation addresses both unilateral injunctive relief and liquidated damages
criteria_results.reasoning: Recommends a mutual equitable-relief clause and deleting § 9.2 liquidated damages.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_017: Liability cap recommendation is to reject
criteria_results.reasoning: Recommends deleting § 14 entirely and notes the Playbook has no fallback for any cap.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_015: Recommends handling data privacy in separate DPA
criteria_results.reasoning: Recommends deleting § 12.1(a)-(c) and handling personal data in a separate DPA.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_007: Discusses enforceability concerns with overbroad non-solicitation
criteria_results.reasoning: Calls the non-solicit an overbroad restraint that is disproportionate for a ~12,000-employee company, notes the § 5.2 acknowledgment is meant to aid enforcement, and says market provisions include carve-outs.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_006: Notes potential impossibility of 5-business-day notice for subpoenas
criteria_results.reasoning: Notes that compliance with a short-return subpoena would be impossible without breach.

criteria_results.title: Report correctly identifies DataPulse draft as a 'Mutual Confidentiality and Restrictive Covenant Agreement'
criteria_results.reasoning: Refers to the draft as the 'Mutual Confidentiality and Restrictive Covenant Agreement'.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_018: Notes increased litigation exposure from third-party beneficiary designation
criteria_results.reasoning: Says the designation multiplies potential claimants and enables strategic, fragmented litigation.

criteria_results.title: Report addresses Section 8 (Governing Law) with correct section reference
criteria_results.reasoning: Cites Draft §§ 8.1-8.3 for governing law and forum.

criteria_results.title: Report output filename is correct
criteria_results.reasoning: Output is nda-deviation-report.docx, titled NDA Deviation Report.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_016: Unilateral publicity rated Critical or High risk
criteria_results.reasoning: Publicity is rated Critical.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_005: Discusses operational impracticability for large public company
criteria_results.reasoning: Notes the disclosure log raises privilege issues and operational burden, and that the consent veto creates a bottleneck.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_014: Notes impact on Hightower's corporate reorganization or acquisition
criteria_results.reasoning: Notes DataPulse would get a veto over the NDA's continuity in a Hightower reorganization, change of control or divestiture.
